subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Symbiosis is a biological relationship where two different species live in close association with each other.
• In 2023, a team of researchers studied symbiotic relationships in thirty coral reef ecosystems.
• Coral reefs are marine structures built by colonies of coral polyps.
• The team found that coral reefs displaying high biodiversity were also likely to contain specialized cleaning stations.
• One explanation for this relationship is that cleaning stations may attract diverse fish species, which establish mutualistic relationships that support the reef's overall health.
prompt: The student wants to present the study's findings to an audience already familiar with symbiosis. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Cleaning stations may attract diverse fish species that establish mutualistic relationships supporting reef health.
choices.B: The team studied symbiotic relationships in thirty coral reef ecosystems, which are marine structures built by coral polyps.
choices.C: Researchers found that coral reefs displaying high biodiversity were likely to contain specialized cleaning stations, which may attract diverse fish species that establish mutualistic relationships.
choices.D: Coral reefs were likely to contain specialized cleaning stations when they displayed high biodiversity, researchers found; symbiosis occurs when two different species live in close association.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. It describes the study's findings in a way that assumes the audience is already familiar with symbiosis.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. This choice doesn't fully describe the findings of the study, because it doesn't include anything about biodiversity or coral reefs.
